component.name: Comfy Desktop
component.summary: Install and manage isolated ComfyUI environments

description.p: Comfy Desktop installs and manages independent ComfyUI environments for generative AI workflows, with bundled Python, PyTorch and GPU packages, snapshots and updates.
This community package downloads the official upstream AppImage unmodified. Update the desktop app with Flatpak; ComfyUI environments are managed by the app.
This package disables automatic Desktop update downloads and installation at each launch while preserving other settings. Upstream update checks still run.

The app can access all devices for NVIDIA CUDA inference. A compatible host NVIDIA driver and matching Flatpak NVIDIA driver extension are required. Custom nodes requiring a host compiler or CUDA toolkit are not supported by default.

ComfyUI installations, shared models and download caches persist in this app's private storage. To use an existing installation or models elsewhere, grant that directory: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/models org.comfy.ComfyDesktop. Undo overrides with flatpak override --user --reset org.comfy.ComfyDesktop.
